modules.name: Yeno’s Orbit
modules.author: Yeno
modules.description: Your music in orbit. A circular cover ringed by a visualizer that glows brighter as the song plays, a progress arc with a glowing moon, a twinkling starfield, a live seek bar and controls on frosted glass. v1.3: make it yours - 6 colour themes, 4 visualizer rings, sky, seek bar, controls, title and lyrics styles, spinning cover, song change animations, background variants, plus the queue bar and audio format badge. New: galaxy, black hole, deep nebula and aurora backgrounds. Tap the artist name or the song title to open their page. Top and bottom padding sliders fit the player to any screen.

modules.name: Yeno’s Orbit Lite
modules.author: Yeno
modules.description: Lite version for low-end devices, still in space. A pre-rendered milky way and starfield with a soft twinkle sit behind the player (drawn from pictures, so almost free for the GPU). The same circular cover, visualizer ring, progress moon, glass controls, colour themes, text, lyrics and padding options, but without the live nebula, galaxy and black hole shaders, shooting stars, cover rim, wave seek bar, glowing play-button and equalizer-icon shaders, and without blur in the animations. Pick No stars in the background variants for the lightest look.

modules.name: Yeno's Orbit Tablet Support
modules.author: Yeno
modules.description: Tablet edition for Tablet 3:2 screens: the whole player is scaled up and the sky fills the screen. Your music in orbit. A circular cover ringed by a visualizer that glows brighter as the song plays, a progress arc with a glowing moon, a twinkling starfield, a live seek bar and controls on frosted glass. v2.0: make it yours - 6 colour themes, 4 visualizer rings, sky, seek bar, controls, title and lyrics styles, spinning cover, song change animations, background variants, plus the queue bar and audio format badge. New: galaxy, black hole, deep nebula and aurora backgrounds. Tap the artist name or the song title to open their page. Top and bottom padding sliders fit the player to any screen.

modules.name: Miku Player
modules.author: you
modules.description: Immersive card with edge progress, a spinning vinyl, 3 lyric styles (Classic, Kinetic, Karaoke), 5 seek bars, 7 song-change animations, 8 vinyl styles (Classic, Colored, Splatter, Smoke, Heart-shaped, Split color, Liquid-filled, Glitter), 4 cover plastics (Glossy shrink-wrap, PVC sleeve, Hype sticker, Worn sleeve), a second player 'Miku Vinyl' (big translucent vinyl over the cover with a tonearm, portrait and landscape) a third player 'Miku Home' (same layout as Miku on a wooden table with a turntable) and backgrounds (Aurora, Ambient Pulse, Matrix Spectrum, Adaptive solid colour) Lyrics icon button and an optional queue bar. A fourth player 'Mivinyls' (only the vinyl disc and the tonearm, portrait and landscape). Miku v2: glass card with the cover in the middle and a spinning vinyl behind it. Every player can show the audio quality.
